claims.claim: Yet on October 14, Democratic nominee David Crowley shifted the conversation to the regulation of artificial intelligence.
claims.bestSource: As data centers remain potent political issue, David Crowley offers plan to regulate artificial intelligence in Wisconsin
claims.evidence: In a governor’s race that has focused more on data center construction than artificial intelligence technology, Democratic gubernatorial candidate David Crowley on Tuesday announced a plan for state regulations on AI aimed at protecting vulnerable Wisconsinites. Instead, Milwaukee County Executive David Crowley eked out a comeback victory to win the Democratic nomination.

claims.claim: In a statement, Crowley cited personal concerns: he and his wife are raising three daughters in the age of social media and AI, and worries about strangers messaging children, fake images circulating in schools, or scams draining grandparents’ savings.
claims.bestSource: As data centers remain potent political issue, David Crowley offers plan to regulate artificial intelligence in Wisconsin
claims.evidence: “Like so many parents, Ericka and I are raising our three girls in the age of social media and AI, and we’re navigating things no generation before us has ever had to, worrying about whether a stranger is messaging our kids, or a fake picture of our daughter is going around school, or even scammers trying to drain a grandparent’s life savings,” Crowley said.
